Definition: adverb from a compound of G3361 and ἀμός (somebody); by no means:--not so.
BiblicalUsage: The word means by no means, not so, and it is Peter's answer twice, when he is told to eat what the law calls unclean: not so, Lord, for I have never eaten anything common or unclean.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Peter's refusal is the honest voice of a man who loved the law: he said not so to God Himself, and God had to tell him three times that what He has cleansed is clean.
